records.scope: Applies to every PING evidence driver that attaches claim verdicts. Does not apply to mission-level verdicts.
records.statement: attachClaimVerdict accepts CONFIRMED | REFUTED | UNCLEAR only. Experiment-level outcomes (SUPPORTED / FALSIFIED / INCONCLUSIVE) belong in the mission result's verdict field, never as claim verdicts. Driver C failed on this; driver C2 reworded thesis outcomes as survival statements with claim verdicts (4x REFUTED-as-headline, 1x UNCLEAR, 1x CONFIRMED survivor) and it worked.
records.title: verdict_vocab.attachClaimVerdict accepts CLAIM_VERDICTS only

records.scope: Applies to every MissionRuntime driver on this journal. Does not apply to runtimes with different transition semantics.
records.statement: missionRuntime.complete() only transitions from status='running' (or held). After a lease-reset to 'created', complete() succeeds silently and changes nothing. Driver C2's 'COMPLETED' print was a lie; driver C3 did assign -> start -> complete and read the row back. Never print a terminal status without reading the mission row.
records.title: complete() is a silent no-op unless the mission is running; always read the row back

records.scope: Applies to every query against ping_events on this journal. Does not apply to tables with a real correlation_id column.
records.statement: ping_events has no correlation_id column. Correlation is metadata->>'correlation_id', per index idx_ping_events_correlation. Queries joining or filtering on correlation must use the JSONB path.
records.title: ping_events correlation lives in metadata, not a column

records.scope: Applies to every evidence-native script/artifact in this lane. Does not claim the order catches everything — the 60-80 fabrication was caught by the render, not the ledger.
records.statement: Build the claim ledger with MAXIMUM DEFENSIBLE WORDING before running the accuracy pass, not after. In block 40-60 the ledger is what caught the near-miss 'the app never issues SET' — it entered the script only in the attributed, narrowed CL-07 form with U1 stated as unverified in the same paragraph. Ledger-first made the pass a check, not a rescue.
records.title: Ledger before accuracy pass: the ledger is the detection surface

records.scope: Applies to technical pieces whose claims rest on trials/records. Does not apply to brand or narrative pieces where no trial evidence exists.
records.statement: For evidence-native technical content, deterministic frames rendered from recorded trial outputs preserve the claim chain; prompt-led AI video generation would fabricate terminal sessions and sever it. The render is also a second detection surface: three invented RETURNING id values (7, 8, 12) were caught in draft frames S03/S05 and replaced with recorded outcomes before assembly. Compiler default going forward: narration + rendered evidence frames + ffmpeg assembly.
records.title: Rendered evidence frames are the compiler default for technical pieces

records.scope: Applies to every artifact whose headline is a human decision. Does not apply to internal working titles.
records.statement: Keep the headline a parameterized slot (H1/H2/H3) from script through compiled artifact; slot the pick in on the human's word with zero other changes. Never invent a headline stronger than the evidence map supports. The 60-80 artifact carries the slot on S01 with headline-agnostic narration.
records.title: Headline stays parameterized until the human pick
